---
title: "Why sharpening matters"
date: 2026-07-14
categories: [sharpening, tools]
---

Spent the whole session just sharpening, and it might be the most useful thing I've done
so far.

The difference between a dull and a sharp chisel isn't subtle — it's the difference
between crushing the wood fibres and slicing them. A sharp edge left a surface that didn't
even need sanding.

::: callout-note
The test that stuck with me: a truly sharp edge will pare a clean, curling shaving off the
end grain of soft pine. A dull one just tears it.
:::

Everything on the [roadmap](../roadmap.qmd) sits on top of this. Worth the session.
